sections.ingredients:
Sufficient Ingredients to make water decoction:- 

 Nimbu – Lemon juice (Citrus Limon) – Anti-inflammatory, Analgesic, helpful in Gastric, act as an antacid, helps in balancing and managing the pH level. It is also beneficial for other problems like relief from scurvy, sore throat, constipation, kidney stones, canker sores, and gum disorders. This herb also helps to lower the blood pressure, decrease stress, maintain healthy skin and promote a healthy liver 
 Saikharika – Achyranthes aspera – It is a group of herbs which is used in expelling Doshas from the neck and head. It has the property of microbial, anti-parasitic action. 
 Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica – It is an Ayurvedic herb used as a digestive and carminative herb. Helpful in digestion, increase appetite, give relief from abdominal colic pain, also useful in treating piles. 
 Amla – Phyllanthus emblica – One of the best rasayan which is helpful as a rejuvenating agent, anti-aging medicine and immunity modulator. 

 Other ingredients 

 Sauvarchala Lavana – Sochal salt 
 Vida Lavana – Black salt 
 Saindhava Lavana – Rock salt 
 Samudra Lavana – Common salt 
 Romaka Lavana – Earthen salt 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Hingu – Ferula asafoetida 
 Shunti – Zingiber officinalis 
 Chincha – Tamarindus indica 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Shuddha Vatsanabha – Purified Aconitum ferox 
 Shankha Bhasma – Ash of Conch Shell 
 Vali – Purified and processed Sulphur
sections.rasa_herbal_purified_mercury:
Method of Mahashankh Vati Preparation 

 Take all the ingredient up to 10 grams 
 Powder all the ingredients and mix well. 
 Now mix these into the decoction to make its paste and after making the paste, make its pills of 150 mg. 

 Medicinal Properties of Mahashankh Vati 
 Mahashankh Vati is an effective Ayurvedic preparation that is able to keep the balance of Vata and Pitta dosha, it possesses carminative, stomachic, and digestive properties etc. The properties that provide a healing effect in various body ailments. 
 It is very useful in digestive troubles. It is good for improving digestive power in case of indigestion. Helpful in reducing intestinal pain. It lessens the formation of gas, which might be due to irregular food habits like heavy food or overeating. Gives relief in gastritis, reduces the inflammation and pain. Mahashankh vati has the property to reduce the acidity and is even beneficial in malabsorption syndrome, where it enhances the absorption of nutrients and promotes strength to the body. Suitable to be used in, piles/hemorrhoids, bleeding problems, and pain etc. It is one of the helpful remedies for dyspepsia, indigestion, abdominal pain, eliminates bloating and abdominal gas. Even useful to enhance the appetite. Improves the liver functions.
sections.indications:
Indigestion 
 Malabsorption 
 Abdominal pain 
 Acidity 
 Piles 
 Dyspepsia 
 Bloating of gas 
 Diarrhea 
 Irritable Bowel Syndrome 
 Ulcerative Colitis
sections.dose: Two tablets twice daily with plain water after meals.
sections.contraindications:
Problems of low BP and low heart beat can arise due to its overdose. 
 Avoid pregnancy and lactation. 
 Take under medical supervision. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Mahashankh Vati – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali Agnimandya Roga Adhikara 186 – 187. 
 Introduction 
 Mahashankh Vati is an Ayurvedic formulation that consists of a mixture of herbs and minerals. This is known to consist of many ingredients. The herbs present in this formulation are known for their properties like digestive, antipyretic, analgesic, appetizer and anti-rheumatic etc. 
 Ingredients 
 Sufficient Ingredients to make water decoction:- 
 
 Nimbu – Lemon juice (Citrus Limon) – Anti-inflammatory, Analgesic, helpful in Gastric, act as an antacid, helps in balancing and managing the pH level. It is also beneficial for other problems like relief from scurvy, sore throat, constipation, kidney stones, canker sores, and gum disorders. This herb also helps to lower the blood pressure, decrease stress, maintain healthy skin and promote a healthy liver 
 Saikharika – Achyranthes aspera – It is a group of herbs which is used in expelling Doshas from the neck and head. It has the property of microbial, anti-parasitic action. 
 Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica – It is an Ayurvedic herb used as a digestive and carminative herb. Helpful in digestion, increase appetite, give relief from abdominal colic pain, also useful in treating piles. 
 Amla – Phyllanthus emblica – One of the best rasayan which is helpful as a rejuvenating agent, anti-aging medicine and immunity modulator. 
 
 Other ingredients 
 
 Sauvarchala Lavana – Sochal salt 
 Vida Lavana – Black salt 
 Saindhava Lavana – Rock salt 
 Samudra Lavana – Common salt 
 Romaka Lavana – Earthen salt 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Hingu – Ferula asafoetida 
 Shunti – Zingiber officinalis 
 Chincha – Tamarindus indica 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Shuddha Vatsanabha – Purified Aconitum ferox 
 Shankha Bhasma – Ash of Conch Shell 
 Vali – Purified and processed Sulphur 
 Rasa – Herbal purified Mercury 
 
 Method of Mahashankh Vati Preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredient up to 10 grams 
 Powder all the ingredients and mix well. 
 Now mix these into the decoction to make its paste and after making the paste, make its pills of 150 mg. 
 
 Medicinal Properties of Mahashankh Vati 
 Mahashankh Vati is an effective Ayurvedic preparation that is able to keep the balance of Vata and Pitta dosha, it possesses carminative, stomachic, and digestive properties etc. The properties that provide a healing effect in various body ailments. 
 It is very useful in digestive troubles. It is good for improving digestive power in case of indigestion. Helpful in reducing intestinal pain. It lessens the formation of gas, which might be due to irregular food habits like heavy food or overeating. Gives relief in gastritis, reduces the inflammation and pain. Mahashankh vati has the property to reduce the acidity and is even beneficial in malabsorption syndrome, where it enhances the absorption of nutrients and promotes strength to the body. Suitable to be used in, piles/hemorrhoids, bleeding problems, and pain etc. It is one of the helpful remedies for dyspepsia, indigestion, abdominal pain, eliminates bloating and abdominal gas. Even useful to enhance the appetite. Improves the liver functions. 
 Indications 
 
 Indigestion 
 Malabsorption 
 Abdominal pain 
 Acidity 
 Piles 
 Dyspepsia 
 Bloating of gas 
 Diarrhea 
 Irritable Bowel Syndrome 
 Ulcerative Colitis 
 
 Dose 
 Two tablets twice daily with plain water after meals. 
 Contraindications 
 
 Problems of low BP and low heart beat can arise due to its overdose. 
 Avoid pregnancy and lactation. 
 Take under medical supervision. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
